decisionsTitle: The home page's four sections: steps, why, the photo strip and the numbers, as components (amending §692)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11:** build the home page now, «with empty photo slots and the plan's defaults», behind its own switch, which stays off. His standing rule of 2026-10-10 applies: component-based, one named Server Component per section with typed props, each drawn on `/admin/design` → «Mostre», everything the club sees a setting (`docs/REDESIGN.md` § The visual system). Phase 3 is three chains: the page, its setting «Pagina principală» with four reserved slots, the hero, the next run and the run sections (`feat/home-page`); these four sections (this one); and a third that puts them into the slots. So this change is components, their domain, fixtures and tests — no route, no setting. Decisions 6, 7 and 8 of the plan are taken by their defaults. **Decision — four Server Components under `src/modules/home/ui/`.** Each takes typed props and draws its own glyphs on the server, so no element crosses into a client component (§370); colour only from `brand.ts` tokens and the palette (§694); every link the house `ArrowButtonLink` or a 44-pixel link (§521, BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 6); no island. - **`StepsBand` — «Prima dată».** A heading, one sentence, five numbered steps from the calendar to the coffee after the run (an `
    `: stacked on a phone, two across from `sm`, five from `md`), each a glyph in a round seat, and «Cum funcționează» as an outlined arrow pill to the club page the setting names (decision 5). No page named, no button. - **`WhyList` — «De ce» and the quote.** Four reasons, each a glyph, a short title and one sentence (one, two, four to the row), and under them the club's quote in Caveat (`--font-signature`, still never preloaded, §460) as a `
changelogLine: - **The home page's four sections, on the home page** — «Prima dată» with its five steps, «De ce» with the club's quote, the photo strip that scrolls sideways under the thumb with a link to Instagram, and the numbers band, each one component, drawn on «Sistemul de design» → «Mostre»; every word in both languages or the site's own, no photo the club did not choose, no figure the club did not give. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the home page's four sections — «Prima dată», «De ce», the photo strip and the numbers band — when they render at 320 pixels, then each stacks into one column (the numbers two to the row), every link is a 44-pixel target, and the photo strip scrolls sideways inside itself with CSS scroll snap and no script, as a named region a keyboard reaches, so the page never scrolls sideways (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-sections-render.test.ts`.

Given a text the club types for the home page's sections, when it is saved, then it is Romanian and English or neither, one side alone refused on the empty side's path; an empty box draws the site's own words in the reader's language, and the quote and its author are drawn only when the club wrote them (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-domain.test.ts`, `home/home-sections-render.test.ts`.

Given the numbers band, when its figures are read, then the years are whole years since the founding day the club typed on the club's calendar, the runners are the count the club typed, the runs a week are the weekdays of every series that repeats weekly, and «100%» free is drawn only when every coming date of those runs, a cancelled one aside, is free; a figure without its fact is left out and a band with none is not drawn (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-domain.test.ts`.

Given the home page's photo strip, when it renders, then it holds only stored pictures of the gallery chosen by id — at most twelve, each once, in the club's order, never a film's poster — each drawn lazily with the ladder's `srcset` for its square tile, and links the club's Instagram as a link in a new tab, never an embed; with no picture chosen nothing is drawn (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-domain.test.ts`, `home/home-sections-render.test.ts`, `media/ladder.test.ts`.

Given `/admin/design` → «Mostre», when it renders, then it draws the home page's four sections by the components the page renders, inside the new look's preview box, from sample content that names no person but the sample member, with the strip's empty places drawn there alone (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `design/design-page.test.ts`.
